purpose: Review of P-0003 at the upper separation edge: two species-A particles at rest, separation 6.0 along x, centred at (5,5), T=2, dt=0.01. Together with 002 this checks whether the power law holds for r in 4 to 6 (outside the close approach at r=3). Pre-registered threshold: error (RMSE/10) at or below 0.03 passes.
